predictions.rationale: Primary class representing a Sequence Diagram; defines its structure, behavior, and integration with ArgoUML’s diagram framework.
Provides the graph model (nodes/edges) that underlies a Sequence Diagram, mapping UML interaction elements to visual objects.
Factory responsible for creating instances of Sequence Diagrams and their basic components; key entry point when the feature is invoked.
Renderer that draws the diagram’s figures (lifelines, messages, activations) on screen; central to visual appearance of Sequence Diagrams.
Module class that registers the Sequence Diagram subsystem with ArgoUML; controls loading, initialization, and feature availability.
UI action (menu/toolbar) that lets users create a new Sequence Diagram; bridges user interaction with diagram creation logic.
Figure class representing a Message arrow in a Sequence Diagram; key element for showing interactions over time.
Figure class depicting an object’s lifeline (vertical timeline); essential visual component of Sequence Diagrams.
Interaction mode handling mouse/gesture input for adding new Message figures; directly supports editing of Sequence Diagrams.
Figure representing a classifier role/object across the top axis; fundamental for showing participating objects in a Sequence Diagram.
